about: [O6] The drive-through (brief O6 §4): from the bed's start, E into the coupe, down the east pavement, across the junction, up the west pavement and into a shop window, by the keys (W / S / A / D: pure pursuit on a path, tools/lib/o6_smash.mjs drive). Every kind of the set goes over or breaks by the car; the car is never inside a standing thing; after it, nothing floats, nothing is inside a wall, everything rests. Then out of the car and on foot into what lies (walkinto): a stall, a newsstand, a call box over on the pavement stop a man. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o6_drive.json
